info.title: API.SH: H&M
info.description: The H&M API from API.SH: public H&M data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Products of one H&M category in one market (locale such as en_us, en_gb, de_de), with sort, facet filters and paging. Each product has the same fields as `/hm/v1/search`: article id, name, brand, price, regular price and sale flag, colour, category, availability, markers, sizes with stock levels, other colours, link, images and `raw`. Also the sort options and facets (each with its filter values, counts and whether it is selected). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. An unknown category answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-category

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market and language as in hm.com links: en_us (default), en_gb, de_de, fr_fr, sv_se, ...

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet filter `facet:value` from `facets[].values[].value`, e.g. `colorWithNames:black_000000` or `fits:Muscle fit`. Repeat the parameter (or join with `||`) for several, up to 10.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One H&M article by number or link: name, brand, price and regular price, sale flag, colour, category, availability, sizes with stock levels, the other colours (article ids, links, images), markers, link and images, in the given market.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An hm.com product link (its locale sets the market), instead of `id`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on H&M for keywords in one market (locale such as en_us, en_gb, de_de, fr_fr, sv_se), with sort, department and facet filters (one or several combined). Each product: article id, name, brand, price, regular price and sale flag, colour (name, hex, colour groups), category, availability, new-arrival flag, markers, sizes with stock levels, other colours, link, images and `raw`. Also the departments and facets (each with its filter values and counts) for narrowing the search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-search

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market and language as in hm.com links: en_us (default), en_gb, de_de, fr_fr, sv_se, ...

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: A department id from `departments`, e.g. men_all, ladies_all.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet value from `facets` (its `value`), e.g. colorWithNames:black_000000. Repeat `filter` (or join values with `||`) to combine up to 10 facets, e.g. `filter=colorWithNames:black_000000&filter=fits:Loose fit`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every H&M store in the locale's country: store code, name, status, phone, address, city, state, postal code, coordinates, opening hours and exceptions, and departments. Filter by name, city, state or postal code with `q`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hm-stores

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Market as in hm.com links, e.g. en_us, en_gb, de_de (default en_us).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only stores whose name, city, state or postal code contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
